notes: Fixed captured profiles being silently dropped instead of retried when the backend responds with HTTP 429 (rate-limited — sometimes shown as the hosting provider's "Just a moment..." page). The offline retry queue only recognized network failures and 5xx errors as retryable; 429 fell through as a permanent failure and that lead was lost instead of queued. It's now queued and retried automatically like any other transient failure. Also paced the retry sweep itself (small gap between items, and it backs off for the rest of that cycle the moment it hits another 429) so retrying a backlog can't re-trigger the same rate limit.
